newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO military court sentences Arafat guard to death.
newsitem.headline: PLO military court sentences Arafat guard to death.

text.p: A Palestinian military court sentenced a member of Yasser Arafat's presidential guard to death and two others to long prison sentences on Tuesday for collaborating with Israel, witnesses said.
The three were arrested last month and charged with terrorising, abducting and killing Palestinians on orders from a "foreign country".
The three guards admitted to the crimes but their lawyers said later investigators used force to obtain the confessions.
The court sentenced a fourth man who was not a member of the presidential guard to five years in prison for similar charges.
Witnesses identified the guard sentenced to death as Fawzi Sawalha, 21. Sawalha's laywer said he would appeal the sentence.
